chieftain_mk9.name: Chieftain Mk 9
chieftain_mk9.authority: The owner, 2026-11-02: "also update the cheiftainn mk 3 and mk 9", then "the cheiftain mk 3 and mk 9s look identical and way way too smimilar to the inspirations, make them look much more different". Release 269 (item/italy-korea-bmp-267, profiles/chieftainMk9X.ts on chieftain10X.ts's buildChieftainMk10Family) builds the Chieftain Mk 9 (a Mk 6 after every phase of Totem Pole, with IFCS, 1979) on the fleet's source-built Mk 10 castings without the Stillbrew blocks and the horns they sit on: the bare cast turret nose with the gun slot open and a canvas boot, the NBC pack with a net roll, no ranging gun. No Commons photograph is labelled Mk 9; the packet uses its base Mk 6 and dated 1979-90 BAOR photographs of IFCS-era Chieftains before Stillbrew (the Mk 5 to the Mk 9 looked externally the same). It won its blind A/B against the round-268 build 2-0 (chieftainr268b, Opus medium, Sonnet medium), and both critics judged the four marks Mk 3, Mk 5, Mk 9 and Mk 10 distinct. No 3D model exists for this mark; numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
chieftain_mk9.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule). Width over the hull's fender cases (marking decals excluded: their seats are regenerated). Length from the stern to the 120 mm muzzle with the gun forward. Tallest is the tip of the whip antenna; the structural turret roof stands 2.45 m and the commander's cupola optic 3.09 m.
